verdict.rationale: Mem0's first-party docs describe registrable webhooks that send HTTP POST requests to user-specified URLs when memories are created, updated, deleted, or categorized. A programmatic consumer can configure and manage these subscriptions directly. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, documented delivery details such as signing, retries and payload schema.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: You can configure webhooks to send HTTP POST requests to your specified URLs whenever memories are created, updated, deleted, or categorized.
Webhooks enable real-time notifications for memory events in your Mem0 project.
Configure and manage webhooks to receive real-time notifications about memory events
